image_description: A stocky, greyish-brown wombat is positioned in a grassy outdoor environment, leaning down to eat or drink from a small woven bamboo bowl. The animal has a robust, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse fur, short powerful limbs with visible claws, and a broad, blunt head with small eyes and rounded ears. A watermark text '© David...' is visible in the bottom right corner.
